brand.sub: From signing to releasing the money. Every step happens in Sada, recorded and protected by escrow.

escrow.title: The amount is held in escrow
escrow.body: The amount is held from your wallet in a Sada escrow account. It doesn't reach the creator before you approve the content and the post is verified.

escrow.ifLate: Balance not completed within {{duration}}? The offer is cancelled with no fees.

brand.q1: When is the money taken from my wallet?
brand.a1: Only when the creator accepts. It's held in escrow and not passed on before you approve and the post is verified.
brand.q2: Can the price change after signing?
brand.a2: No. The price locks when you sign. If the creator's rate card changes before sending, we show you the difference to decide.
brand.q3: What if I don't like the content?
brand.a3: Ask for changes within the agreed rounds, and you can add a paid round. If you disagree, open a dispute in the app with evidence.
brand.q4: What if the creator doesn't deliver?
brand.a4: The contract is cancelled automatically after the deadline, and the full amount returns to your wallet.
brand.a5: Yes, as long as the creator hasn't replied. After acceptance, cancelling follows the contract terms.
